up: Retrieve all distinct compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1157562 (docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1157562'). For each compound, output: compound ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), compound preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Use a LEFT JOIN on compound_structures so that compounds without a SMILES entry are still included with a null SMILES value. Order the results by compound ChEMBL ID ascending. Compounds are linked to the document via compound_records: docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id and compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Use DISTINCT to ensure each compound appears only once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1157562' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
